purpose: First-game guidance matched to the current v0.7.1 candidate recommended starter Decks.

tips.military-general-forward-doctrine: Use Forced March and Advance Guard to choose the battles that matter. Save Command for Rally when a battle is close or Rout when a second attack can turn one win into immediate Front Line progress.
tips.military-commandant-holdfast: Do not rush every advance. Make the opponent attack prepared ground, then combine Entrench or Repel with Landslide and Court Martial retreat pressure so one defensive win opens a counterattack.
tips.diplomats-ambassador-open-channels: Lead with low-Stake, easy-to-accept Proposals and keep varying the Proposal you offer. Accepted Terms advance the five-Proposal Peace Treaty and your card flow; make refusals costly with battle pressure and Sanctions.
tips.diplomats-senator-procedure-endures: Risk larger Stakes when the payoff matters, but keep cards available for Political Capital and Safe Conduct. Establish Sanctions early enough that repeated refusals become progressively worse for the opponent.
tips.financiers-banker-sound-investment: Put cards you can afford to delay into Treasury, then use Line of Credit and Liquidation to buy Deeds ahead of normal Capital pacing. Preserve enough Capital to protect the engine; Corner the Market is your closing threat.
tips.financiers-executive-hostile-expansion: Plan turns so movement, battle, and acquisition happen together. Keep enough Capital or collateral for Hostile Takeover after a successful attack, then use the new Deed and control swing to set up Corner the Market.
tips.intelligence-ranger-field-operations: Use Pathfinders before spending Intel just to bypass hostile Territory text. Save Fieldcraft, Surveillance, and Interference for effects or hidden commitments that would actually stop a Mission or decisive attack.
tips.intelligence-spymaster-mission-network: Keep a second eligible Mission in Hand before completing the first so Mission Control keeps the chain moving. Use Contraband and Ruined Storehouse to recover completed Missions, and save Sleeper Network for a turn with several useful Actions lined up.
tips.mystics-alchemist-first-principles: Use Threefold Vision to seed Hand, Discard, and Graveyard early. Plan the first Hand-to-Graveyard sacrifice each turn so Materia Prima replaces it, and save Rend the Veil or Transmutation support for the Rite of Blood battle.
tips.mystics-spirit-walker-unbroken-circle: Use Nature's Altar and your Overlays to establish a protected Rite early. Keep a valuable Arcane card available for Guardians of the Circle, and bank Witchcraft or Rend the Veil so Shattering can turn established power into a decisive battle.
tips.inquisition-grand-inquisitor-final-judgm: Build Conviction before committing to a major Purge. After a battle win, use Final Judgment's discounted Purge immediately; Attrition can make that same win dump the opponent's Reserve into the Graveyard.
tips.inquisition-witch-hunter-relentless-purs: Keep 2 Conviction available when the opponent attacks. Use Confession, Court Martial, or Contingency Plan to force the defensive win, then turn their ended turn into immediate forward pressure with Relentless Pursuit.
